plugins.name: pin
plugins.description: Pin + Protocol + Fact disciplines for agent-driven research: lock design decisions against silent rollback, make every data element traceable to code, keep citeable observations structured, and keep the human genuinely in the loop.

plugins.name: vibe-slides
plugins.description: Author academic slide decks via a markdown DSL: extract theme/components from a .pptx template, iterate on a content-only outline, then compile to .pptx with pptxgenjs.

plugins.name: sop
plugins.description: Standard operating procedure skills for repeatable engineering workflows, including GitLab merge request and GitHub pull request submission.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Lightweight experiment workflow with reproducible Protocols and materialized internal Facts.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Research-design skills grounded in top systems papers: create-novelty turns a topic into an OSDI/SOSP-grade novelty and experiment plan, using 100 dissected OSDI/SOSP papers.

plugins.name: me
plugins.description: Human-centered skills that build the user's understanding rather than finish a task: teach-me-this trains research ability by having the user work through 2–3 exercises on a published paper: they write a complete answer, it is scored against a fixed rubric, then the paper's answer is revealed and they analyze the gap.

plugins.name: safeguard
plugins.description: Claude Code native mod: automatically translate submitted text to English and audit recorded request context locally after send.
